description_en: Queries the available regions for the product
description_zh: 查询产品支持的地域列表
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc list-regions --spec-code Next --accept-language zh-CN --max-results 20 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0axxxx --api-version 2024-07-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRegions

parameters.description_en:
The product name. The default value is Next. Valid values:

- Next: The E-HPC Cluster product, formerly known as E-HPC NEXT.

- Instant: The E-HPC Instant product.
